Then a providential event: a travelling show brings a woman who was changed into a spider for disobeying her parents.

She is cheaper, you may ask her questions, and her sad story has so much human truth and so clear a moral that she easily defeats the aloof angel, whose miracles are faintly ridiculous: a blind man who grows three new teeth instead of sight, a leper whose sores sprout sunflowers.
The crowd leaves, and the courtyard is as empty as when it rained.
